fact: At the end of 2020 Eswatini had 970 refugees and 1104 asylum-seekers, who are eligible for refugee ID or non-Swazi ID cards, while refugees faced limits registering SIM cards for mobile money because of national ID number requirements.
title: Leveraging Digital ID and e-KYC for the Financial Inclusion of Forcibly Displaced Persons (FDPs): Risks and Opportunities
publisher: Responsible Finance and Inclusion Learning Collaborative (RFILC)
